Advertisement for Faculty
Tuesday, 05 June 2018
5376 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the following posts.
1. Professor in TB and Chest (1)
2. Associate Professors in General Medicine (1), Radio-diagnosis (1), Radiotherapy (1)
2. Assistant Professor in General Medicine (3), TB and Chest (1), Ophthalmology (1), Surgery (1), Pediatrics (1), Radiotherapy (1), Skin and VD (1), Obs and Gynae (2) and Mother and Child Welfare Officer in Obs and Gynae (1)
The applicant should send their application to the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS). The candidates are also invited for a walk in Interview alongwith application and supporting documents at 11 AM on any working day till
15/06/2018
. The appointments would be adhoc till the next Selection Committee of MUHS meets.
Qualification: MBBS with MCI recognized Post-graduate Degree in concerned subject.
Experience : As per MCI and MUHS norms
Pay Scale : As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society
For more details please contact:
Phone: 07152 -284341 to 284355 (Ext. 203) fax: 07152-284333, 284220
Email:
khssgm@rediffmail.com
Website: www.mgims.ac.in
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
